meta.title: Strategy drawer offers all five auction strategies

plan.title: Strategy drawer offers all five auction strategies

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation screen where auction strategy configuration is available.
Set the event to an auction and establish the Rank Based strategy so the strategy badge is available.
Provide the required event title for a create-screen test.
Open the strategy drawer from the current strategy badge.
Assert that all five expected strategies appear and none is disabled or omitted.
